replay.watchStarted: Game launch requested to watch replay
replay.watchFailed: Failed to launch game to watch replay
replay.statistics.title: Match statistics
replay.statistics.notice: All scanned replays in the current profile and category, regardless of search. Files with the same content hash count once; unhashed files count separately. Win rate = wins / (wins + losses); draws and unknown results are excluded. Matchups require two players on distinct known teams; map records include team games. Unknown or corrupt data never implies a result.
replay.statistics.coverage: Excluded {duplicates} duplicate files. {missingDates} matches have no valid played date: included in totals and groups, but not monthly trends.
replay.candidatesNotice: Finding directories does not scan or index replays. Choose a directory to scan manually.
replay.noDirectories: No standard account replay directory found. You can still scan a custom directory.
replay.duplicateNotice: Grouped by indexed SHA-256; files are never merged or deleted automatically. Reindex changed files to update groups.
replay.exportNotice: Selection persists across filters. Export up to 2,000 replays / 1 GiB. Choose a new ZIP path; existing files are never overwritten. Reindex old or changed files first.
replay.analysisNotice: These are decoded protocol components, not APM, build orders or economy analytics. Completed means all three components were decoded.
replay.noAnalysis: No match insights are available. Click Analyze or Reanalyze.
replay.componentUnavailable: This component was not decoded. See the status and warnings above.
replay.previewTruncated: Preview truncated; this is not the complete component.
replay.noItems: Decoded successfully; no records in this component.
replay.title: Replay management
replay.description: Choose a profile and replay type to read its directory. Switching refreshes the index; no folder watching.
replay.search: Search file, map, player or path
replay.empty: No replays in this profile and type. Import a replay or archive, or refresh.
replay.deleteWarning: This permanently deletes the replay file from disk and its index record. This cannot be undone.
replay.partialNotice: Only parsed metadata is shown; match analytics are not available.
replay.noProfiles: No StarCraft profiles found. Configure the StarCraft documents directory in Settings.
replay.scopeNotice: Profile {handle} · {category}. Imports are copied into this profile/type directory.
replay.noInsights: No participant insights are available for this replay.
replay.chartNotice: All players share the same axes. Player colors and metric line styles match the legend. The horizontal axis is game time (16 game loops per second), not elapsed wall time. Only actual samples are connected; missing values are gaps, with no smoothing or estimates. Long replays display up to 1,000 actual samples per player and metric. Display buckets containing missing values remain gaps; valid first and last samples are retained.
replay.noSamples: These samples are not available in this replay.
replay.commands.notice: Recorded command issue times do not prove execution or actual training starts. User IDs belong to game.events and are not assumed to be player IDs. Raw ability IDs are retained; training, construction and other commands cannot yet be reliably distinguished.
replay.commands.missing: No command analysis available. Reanalyze; the replay may also lack game.events.
replay.commands.unsupported: No usable compatible protocol: candidates failed, results were ambiguous, or compression is unsupported. Other replay information remains available.
replay.commands.unverified: Unverified compatibility: replay baseBuild {source} was fully decoded using protocol {decoder}. Results are provisional; successful decoding does not prove field semantics. Do not use as verified statistics or training-start evidence.
replay.commands.corrupt: Command events could not be fully decoded. A potentially incomplete timeline is not displayed.
replay.commands.partial: Command decoding is incomplete; the timeline is unavailable.
replay.timeline.notice: Starts only shows verified initialization events, such as construction or warp-ins. Starts + completions also includes production completions, entity appearances and completed upgrades. Actual training start times for ordinary units are unknown; an entity appearance is not a training start and does not necessarily come from training.
replay.timeline.noStarts: No verified production starts for this player. This does not mean no units were trained or buildings constructed.
replay.productionNotice: Recorded entity appearances, production and upgrades only, not a complete build-command history. Original unit identifiers are retained when no name catalog is available.
replay.noProduction: No production records are available for this participant.
replay.analysisUnavailable: Analysis was attempted, but this replay version or content cannot currently provide match data.
replay.analysisCorrupt: Replay data is corrupt or incomplete; complete match data is unavailable.
replay.partialInsights: Some replay events could not be interpreted. Charts and timelines contain confirmed data only and may be incomplete.
